description: This PHP source file is responsible for setting up and rendering the 'My Leads' list view in the SuiteCRM (a CRM application based on SugarCRM). It includes security checks, loads language-specific strings, initializes list view components, constructs a query for the current user's leads, and renders the list with appropriate headers and layout editing options.

classes.name: ListView
classes.description: A class responsible for rendering list views in the SuiteCRM interface, handling templates, headers, queries, and display of list data.

methods.name: initNewXTemplate
methods.description: Initializes a new list view with a given template file and language strings.

methods.name: setHeaderTitle
methods.description: Sets the header title for the list view display.

methods.name: setQuery
methods.description: Sets the database query parameters for fetching list data.

methods.name: processListView
methods.description: Processes and renders the list data for the view.
